# Opera Concrete & Pavers

> Opera Concrete & Pavers builds concrete driveways, patios and pool decks, stamped concrete, paver driveways and patios, retaining walls and artificial turf for homes in the Orlando area and in Sarasota, Lakewood Ranch and Bradenton.

- Website: https://operaconcretepavers.com
- Orlando & Central Florida crew: https://operaconcretepavers.com/central-florida/
- Sarasota, Lakewood Ranch & Bradenton crew: https://operaconcretepavers.com/sarasota-manatee/
- Service area: Orlando, Kissimmee, Clermont, Oviedo, Winter Garden, Windermere and Central Florida; Sarasota, Lakewood Ranch, Bradenton, Venice and the Suncoast.
- Facts last reviewed: 2026-10-01

## Services

- [Concrete driveways poured for Florida soil, heat and rain](https://operaconcretepavers.com/concrete-driveways/): New, replacement and widened concrete driveways in Greater Orlando and Sarasota–Manatee: 4–6 in. slabs, control joints every 8–12 ft, and 2026 Florida pricing.
- [Concrete walkways built for Florida yards and rights-of-way](https://operaconcretepavers.com/concrete-walkways/): Front walks, side paths and right-of-way sidewalk sections in Greater Orlando and Sarasota–Manatee, built to each city's thickness rules, priced as of October 2026.
- [Concrete patios built for Florida rain and heat](https://operaconcretepavers.com/concrete-patios/): Concrete patio installation and lanai extensions in Greater Orlando and Sarasota-Manatee: thickness, drainage, finishes and Florida prices as of October 2026.
- [Stamped concrete for driveways, patios and pool decks](https://operaconcretepavers.com/stamped-concrete/): Stamped concrete patios, driveways and pool decks in Greater Orlando and Sarasota-Manatee: patterns, spec, slip resistance and Florida prices, Oct. 2026.
- [Concrete Slabs Sized and Based for What Sits on Them](https://operaconcretepavers.com/concrete-slabs/): Concrete pads for sheds, carports, AC and generator units, RV and boat parking, and garage slabs. Florida market range as of October 2026.
- [Concrete Repair Matched to What's Actually Wrong](https://operaconcretepavers.com/concrete-repair/): Crack repair, resurfacing overlays, mudjacking and foam leveling, and cut-out-and-replace for driveways, patios and slabs. Florida range as of October 2026.
- [Paver Driveways Built on a Base That Won't Settle](https://operaconcretepavers.com/paver-driveways/): Paver driveways in 60 mm or 80 mm pavers over a compacted aggregate base with edge restraint. Florida market range as of October 2026, Orlando and Sarasota.
- [Paver Patios, Walkways and Fire-Pit Areas for Florida Backyards](https://operaconcretepavers.com/paver-patios/): Paver patios, walkways, fire-pit areas and lanai extensions in concrete pavers or travertine, on a compacted base. Florida price range as of October 2026.
- [Clean, Re-Sand, Seal and Relevel: Paver Restoration in the Right Order](https://operaconcretepavers.com/paver-sealing/): Paver cleaning, re-sanding with dry or polymeric sand, sealing and releveling sunken pavers. Florida market range $1.50-$3.25/sq ft as of October 2026.
- [Retaining Walls Built With Drainage Behind Them, Not Just a Face of Block](https://operaconcretepavers.com/retaining-walls/): Segmental block retaining walls, raised planters and seat walls with drainage behind the wall. Florida market range $15-$40/sq ft of wall face, October 2026.
- [Pouring and Resurfacing a Concrete Pool Deck in Florida](https://operaconcretepavers.com/concrete-pool-decks/): Concrete pool decks and Kool Deck-style resurfacing in Florida run $5–$15 per sq ft installed as of October 2026, with specs, process and FAQs.
- [Travertine, Shell Stone and Concrete Pavers for a Pool Deck](https://operaconcretepavers.com/pool-deck-pavers/): Pool deck pavers in travertine, shell stone and concrete run $12–$30 per sq ft installed in Florida as of October 2026, including overlays and coping.
